title: Host presence
description: The host's facts about the owner's current host request (F3 B11, DC-10): its route, the paired device and its biometric, the on-screen indicator, the kill switch, each input source's own indicator, and whether the request is final. Written on the host only (index key host_presence, under the protected .supervisor tree); bin/host_access.py decide reads it and never trusts a request for these facts. It is dated (at) and bound to one run and one owner request (run, request), so an old or another request's record never counts. A missing record refuses.

at.description: UTC time the host wrote this record; decide() refuses it once older than host-policy.json presence_max_age_s, or dated in the future.

run.description: The run this record is for; decide() refuses a request of another run.

request.description: The id the host wrote when the owner started the request; decide() refuses a request that names another.

input_indicators.description: Capability id of an input source -> its own indicator is on.

final.description: submitted: a typed or device command was submitted; closed: a spoken turn ended; open: not yet.

detector.description: What ended the turn: the semantic turn detector, a push-to-talk release, or a silence timeout alone (never final).
